basics.name: Aryan Bhosale
basics.label: Master of Science in Computer Science Student
basics.summary: Master of Science in Computer Science student at the University of Maryland, College Park, with a Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering from IIT Bombay. Focused on multimodal machine learning and generative models.

work.name: American Express, India
work.summary: Model Interpretability (MI): Research & Reliability Assessment. Part of the Model Risk Management Team, enforcing model risk compliance frameworks.
highlights: Leveraged domain expertise to analyze AMEX-internal MI methods - SHAP & PDP in explaining model predictions
Innovated and tested an Individual Conditional Effects (ICE) - based framework to quantify confidence in MI techniques
PDP & ALE - on AXGBoost Global Corporate credit risk (6Mn+ data) & GLM AU attrition risk models (4Mn+ data)

work.name: Brown University, USA
work.summary: GATOR: Gradient-Agnostic Topology Optimization Repository. Generative modelling for topology optimization. Guide: Prof. M. Bessa, School of Engineering, Brown University.
highlights: Deployed a TopoDiff-GUIDED with 0.18 Vol. Fraction Error, 0.73 Load Violation & 0.04 Floating Material in PyTorch
Integrated gradient-free optimizers - Genetic Algorithms into a pipeline for generating multiple topologies using evosax

highlights: Academically Mentored 25+ freshmen by conducting weekly laboratory sessions, problem-solving and evaluation

Curating an Omni-modal benchmark (NVIDIA) with explicit multi-modal dependencies to assess audio-visual understanding

projects.name: SeDriCa (Self-driving car)
projects.summary: Team Manager. India's first self-driving car, customized for Indian roads.

Spearheaded hardware testing of a fully-functional autonomous vehicle with custom drive-by-wire & software in ROS
Finetuned YOLOv5 (mAP0.5: 1, MAP0.5:0.95 0.86) for object detection on 1000+ curated tyres, mannequins and barrels

projects.name: Audio-Visual (AV) Grounding & Discrete Speech Tokens for ASR
projects.summary: CSALT Lab, IIT Bombay. Developed AV alignment models for video segmentation + AV retrieval & improved speech recognition using audio codecs.
highlights: Designed IOU-based alignment loss and background activation suppression loss for segmentation on PlacesAudio dataset
Achieved 8%↑ in Image-to-Audio (12A) & 21%↑ in A21 retrieval, 3%↑ in mAP on ADE20K Speech-prompted dataset
Trained code-based ASR models (DAC, Discrete HuBERT, Speech Tokenizer) on LibriSpeech-100hr corpus in Speechbrain
Reduced WER by 11%↓ on test-clean & 8.5%↓ on test-other (Libri Speech-100) through selective use of DAC's RVQ layers

projects.name: AI-Generated Artifact Detection & Explanation Generation
projects.summary: Adobe Research. Part of Inter-IIT Tech Meet. Developing interpretable authenticity verification using vision-language models.
highlights: Performed QLoRa fine-tuning on Qwen2-VL on explanations dataset curated using GPT-4 & Claude-3 API
Implemented tree of thoughts framework to structure VLM reasoning & improve artifact detection (0.72 F1 score)
